questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
Only stop to yield to other traffic.
Vehicles will be entering the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. Stop completely, let other traffic and pedestrians pass, then go when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane need to merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a fluorescent yellow-green background. These signs warn of upcoming curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and horse-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light is about to change to red.
The traffic light is about to change to green.
Stop and wait for traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The traffic light is about to change to red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns that the signal will turn red soon. Slow down and stop before the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are already in the intersection, continue through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Turning right at this intersection is illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming conditions. This sign warns that a side road intersects ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to immediate conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending and drivers need to merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk where people cross the road. Watch for pedestrians and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign alerts drivers that cyclists may be crossing the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign means traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to allow vehicles to safely merge into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn that you are entering or approaching a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and drive at the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead, posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be prepared to stop for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see it on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks solid orange during the day and hollow red at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roads where entry is not allowed. You may see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black lettering or symbols. They inform drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn that you are approaching a school zone or school crossing. Stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black symbols. It tells you that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is on the back of slow-moving vehicles that travel below 25 mph, such as farm equipment, construction vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign. It tells you the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down and be ready to adjust your steering.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions. Flaggers wear bright orange, yellow, or green clothing and use paddles and red flags to direct traffic and workers through construction zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop and wait until it is safe to cross the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign. It tells you the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign. It warns you the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes if needed.
